 Dated this the 7th day of March, 2025  JUDGMENT
The petitioners claim to be in possession of property which has been acquired, for the past more than sixty years.
Their claim for compensation on acquisition has been rejected by Ext.P16.
The petitioners have already approached the Civil Court by filing O.S. No. 134 of 2020 for a declaration of title and injunction against the State and its Officers.
The petitioners submit that they should be treated as deemed owners and given the value for the land.
It is submitted that the value for the structure has already been granted.
2. The Government Pleader submits that the possession is not disputed.
However, it is submitted that Ext.P16 cannot be faulted since the petitioner does not have any valid title over the property.

3. The petitioners rely on the decision of this Court in Baby Joseph v. Chief Secretary [2023 (3) KHC 375] wherein this Court in similar circumstances, held that the finding regarding non eligibility for the compensation, since the petitioner does not have a valid title will not in any manner prevent the petitioner from establishing the WP(C) NO. 3948 OF 2025 2025:KER:21241 rights over the land through a competent Civil Court and once the right is established through competent Civil Court, it will be open to the petitioner to claim compensation based on the declaration by the Civil Court.

entities.text: Baby Joseph v. Chief Secretary [2023 (3) KHC 375]
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: In the said decision, this Court further held that on establishing the title over the land in question in the civil proceedings, the petitioner therein will be entitled to all the benefits contemplated under the provisions of the Act and as provided to land owners similarly situated.
I do not find any reason to take a different view.

It is hence ordered that Ext.P16 will be subject to the decision in O.S. No.134/2020 and if the said suit is decided in favour of the petitioner, the petitioners are free to move the appropriate authority for release of the compensation for the land and such a request shall be considered and ordered by the competent authority without reference to the reasoning in Ext.P16.

Sd/-
